memos.scout:
The honest case for buying is weak. The best points: the coin is alive, has 682 buyers and about $61.6k of volume in the last 15 minutes, and net flow over that window is roughly flat (-0.57 SOL on 262 SOL of buying), so demand has not collapsed outright. The top-3 holder share is low (9.9%), and the completer share of 60% suggests buyers aren't just the creator. Pool depth of 73.5 SOL is adequate for a $20 ticket.

Against that, the signals point the other way. Price is down 25% over 30 minutes and 36% off the 30-minute high, and the last 15 minutes show a 16.8% decline. Sellers (576) nearly match buyers, and sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 1.08. A launch bot was present and the bundle share is 38%, which means a sizable slice of early supply was bought in coordinated fashion. Most coins never recover a dip of this size, and this one has been bleeding.

Verdict: no strong case to buy. The volume is real, but the trend and early sell pressure don't support an entry 30 to 60 minutes out. Skip.
memos.skeptic:
Most likely loss path: a slow bleed, not a dramatic rug. The coin is already 36% off its 30-minute high and down 17% over the last 15 minutes, with net flow at -0.57 SOL, meaning sellers absorbed essentially all the buying (262.34 SOL sold vs 261.76 bought). That is distribution into a fading book, not an accumulation base.

Supporting numbers: bundle_share of 37.9% and completer_share of 60.1% suggest coordinated early supply, with a launch bot present. Sell-to-buy ratio of 1.08 in the first two minutes after graduation shows early holders exiting. Top-5 buyer share is modest (19%), so this is not a single-whale dump, but the dispersed selling keeps the price falling.

At a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost against a pool of only 73.5 SOL, a bounce would need to be large to clear fees. Buying a coin already in drawdown with negative flow is the pattern the base rates punish. Skip.
